title: Epic of Gilgamesh: oldest surviving story
summary: Sumerian poems about Gilgamesh, king of Uruk, some possibly dating to about 2100 BCE, were later combined into an Akkadian epic about friendship, death and the search for immortality.
why: The world's oldest surviving example of narrative literature.

notes.problem: Source says only some poems 'may date' to c. 2100 BCE; summary stated it as fact.
